title: Graft spec frontmatter
description: The manifest part of a spec: the YAML frontmatter of a spec Markdown file. Host-agnostic; the host adapter validates mount, audience and permissions against its surface.

id.description: Stable slug, unique per tenant. Titles change; ids do not.

requires.description: Optional semver ranges keyed by host or component, e.g. { wordpress: '>=7.1' }.

mount.description: Where the customization appears. Slot-specific options are validated against the slot's own schema in the surface.

audience.description: Who sees the customization, in the host's vocabulary (WordPress roles). A visibility rule, not a security boundary.

permissions.description: Adapter-defined permission scopes (resource:action) the customization needs.

triggers.description: Actions the customization takes on its own, without a viewer (ADR 0010), by trigger id. Each runs as the host's service identity with only the permissions listed here, once an administrator approves them.

event.description: Host event the trigger runs on, from the surface.

permissions.description: Permission scopes the service identity is granted for this trigger, and nothing else.

limit.description: Most capability calls one run makes; the rest wait for the next run.

locale.description: Language of the spec body, BCP 47.

schedule.description: When a scheduled trigger runs: every so many hours ("6h") or days ("1d"), days optionally at a time of day in the site's time zone.
